input.text: Fictional applications, health declarations, structured claims, itemized bills, code lookup results, member history and provider statistics; ~300 claims daily

work.text: Five Pi Durable agents with JSON-schema tool loops: enrollment, intake, coding, adjudication, fraud

output.text: Eligibility, bill mismatch, coding finding, per-line pay/deny codes and fraud scores and recommendation recorded via tools

criteria.text: Best quality and reliable tool calling above cost; public benchmarks first, subsequent Langfuse aggregate results; human approves payments

constraints.text: UAE processing required; unknown treated outside UAE; fictional-data exceptions recorded as residency gap; other providers require owner approval; Workers AI and OpenRouter already used

assumptions: Each call sees only relevant structured records, tool definitions and accumulated results, not the whole claim corpus.
Endpoint processing location must be verified for a particular route; absent proof every route is a residency gap.
